# convoy_source (Resource)

A source is where events enter Convoy: an HTTP ingest URL for incoming projects (optionally verified), or a message broker (SQS, Google Pub/Sub, Kafka, RabbitMQ) for outgoing projects.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Incoming project: receive GitHub webhooks and verify their signature.
resource "convoy_source" "github" {
  project_id = var.incoming_project_id
  name       = "github"
  type       = "http"

  verifier = {
    type = "hmac"
    hmac = {
      header   = "X-Hub-Signature-256"
      hash     = "SHA256"
      encoding = "hex"
      secret   = var.github_webhook_secret
    }
  }

  idempotency_keys = ["request.headers.X-GitHub-Delivery"]
}

# Give this URL to GitHub.
output "github_ingest_url" {
  value = convoy_source.github.url
}

# Outgoing project: consume events from an SQS queue.
resource "convoy_source" "orders_queue" {
  name = "orders"
  type = "pub_sub"

  pub_sub = {
    type    = "sqs"
    workers = 4
    sqs = {
      queue_name     = "orders-events"
      default_region = "eu-west-1"
      access_key_id  = var.aws_access_key_id
      secret_key     = var.aws_secret_access_key
    }
  }
}

variable "incoming_project_id" { type = string }
variable "github_webhook_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
variable "aws_access_key_id" { type = string }
variable "aws_secret_access_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Source name.
- `type` (String) Source type: `http` (ingest URL, incoming projects), `pub_sub` (message broker), `rest_api` or `db_change_stream`.

### Optional

- `body_function` (String) JavaScript `transform` function applied to ingested payloads.
- `custom_response` (Attributes) Custom HTTP response returned to the webhook sender. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_response))
- `event_type_location` (String) Where to read the event type from in ingested requests, e.g. `request.body.type`.
- `forward_headers` (List of String) Ingest request headers forwarded to endpoints.
- `header_function` (String) JavaScript `transform` function applied to ingested headers.
- `idempotency_keys` (List of String) Request locations used to de-duplicate events, e.g. `request.headers.X-Request-Id` or `request.body.id`.
- `is_disabled` (Boolean) Whether the source is disabled.
- `project_id` (String) ID of the project the object belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`. Changing this forces a new object to be created.
- `pub_sub` (Attributes) Message broker settings for `pub_sub` sources. Set `type` and the matching nested object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pub_sub))
- `source_provider` (String) Pre-configured provider verification: `github`, `twitter` or `shopify`.
- `verifier` (Attributes) How Convoy verifies requests ingested by an `http` source. Set `type` and the matching nested object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verifier))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier (`uid`) of the source.
- `mask_id` (String) Public identifier used in the ingest URL.
- `url` (String) Ingest URL to give to the webhook provider (`http` sources).

### Nested Schema for `custom_response`

Required:

- `body` (String) Response body.
- `content_type` (String) Response `Content-Type`.


<a id="nestedatt--pub_sub"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pub_sub`

Required:

- `type` (String) Broker type: `sqs`, `google`, `kafka` or `amqp`.
- `workers` (Number) Number of consumer workers.

Optional:

- `amqp` (Attributes) RabbitMQ / AMQP settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pub_sub--amqp))
- `google` (Attributes) Google Cloud Pub/Sub settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pub_sub--google))
- `kafka` (Attributes) Apache Kafka settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pub_sub--kafka))
- `sqs` (Attributes) Amazon SQS settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pub_sub--sqs))

<a id="nestedatt--pub_sub--amqp"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pub_sub.amqp`

Required:

- `host` (String) Broker host.
- `port` (String) Broker port.
- `queue` (String) Queue name.
- `schema` (String) URI scheme, `amqp` or `amqps`.

Optional:

- `bind_exchange` (String) Exchange the queue is bound to.
- `dead_letter_exchange` (String) Dead letter exchange.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password.
- `routing_key` (String) Routing key of the binding.
- `username` (String) Username.
- `vhost` (String) Virtual host.


<a id="nestedatt--pub_sub--google"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pub_sub.google`

Required:

- `project_id` (String) GCP project ID.
- `service_account` (String, Sensitive) Base64 encoded service account JSON key, e.g. `filebase64("sa.json")`.
- `subscription_id` (String) Pub/Sub subscription ID.


<a id="nestedatt--pub_sub--kafka"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pub_sub.kafka`

Required:

- `brokers` (List of String) Broker addresses.
- `topic_name` (String) Topic name.

Optional:

- `auth` (Attributes) Kafka authentication. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pub_sub--kafka--auth))
- `consumer_group_id` (String) Consumer group ID.

<a id="nestedatt--pub_sub--kafka--auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pub_sub.kafka.auth`

Optional:

- `hash` (String) SCRAM hash, `SHA256` or `SHA512`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password.
- `tls` (Boolean) Connect over TLS.
- `type` (String) Authentication type, `plain` or `scram`.
- `username` (String) Username.



<a id="nestedatt--pub_sub--sqs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pub_sub.sqs`

Required:

- `access_key_id` (String) AWS access key ID.
- `default_region` (String) AWS region.
- `queue_name` (String) Queue name.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) AWS secret access key.

Optional:

- `endpoint` (String) Custom SQS endpoint (e.g. LocalStack).



<a id="nestedatt--verifier"></a>
### Nested Schema for `verifier`

Required:

- `type` (String) Verifier type: `noop`, `hmac`, `basic_auth` or `api_key`.

Optional:

- `api_key` (Attributes) Static API key sent in a request header. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verifier--api_key))
- `basic_auth` (Attributes) HTTP basic authentication credentials. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verifier--basic_auth))
- `hmac` (Attributes) HMAC signature verification. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verifier--hmac))

<a id="nestedatt--verifier--api_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `verifier.api_key`

Required:

- `header_name` (String) Header name, e.g. `Authorization`.
- `header_value` (String, Sensitive) Header value.


<a id="nestedatt--verifier--basic_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `verifier.basic_auth`

Required:

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password.
- `username` (String) Username.


<a id="nestedatt--verifier--hmac"></a>
### Nested Schema for `verifier.hmac`

Required:

- `encoding` (String) Signature encoding, `hex` or `base64`.
- `hash` (String) Hash function, e.g. `SHA256` or `SHA512`.
- `header` (String) Header carrying the signature, e.g. `X-Hub-Signature-256`.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Shared HMAC secret.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import convoy_source.github 01H0JA5MEES38RRK3HTEJC647K/01H0JATTVCXZK8FRDX1M1JN3QY
```
